Damage caller, HammerFall input gates and exit ordering, platform-pass exception, and numeric bonus submission agree with document/proposal. All seven changes supported. proposed_facts.reason: Canonical setup orders overlay request, item request/latch and guarded feedback forwarding. The item dispatcher resets for nonpositive xD4C. The document correctly avoids guaranteed activation and an inferred feedback lifetime.

The updater preserves the LightGet exclusion, nonzero decrement tests, secondary-before-primary expiry order, post-destruction overlay sample and final auxiliary decrement. The feedback callee removes rumble ID 3; overlay cleanup reconstructs conditionally rather than guaranteeing restoration.

Assignments, conditional statistics call, attribute-driven random helper and unconditional x2168 increment agree with the proposal and document. Fighter bookkeeping reset does not reattach an item head; loaded values and random incidence remain explicitly deferred.

The helper requests 106 with false only for a different selected ID and ignores the starter's Boolean result. Reconstruction independently associates 0x6A with Hammer motion membership. No guaranteed installation or false-mode interpretation is asserted.

The exact mask is selected by inclusive source-motion membership. Motion-engine consumers show selective resets, including color animation and x2222_b2, rather than blanket preservation. The separately examined platform-pass path explicitly supplies Ft_MF_None and frame zero.

The setter reloads x2338.y from x6B8; Damage completion guards its call with held-Hammer possession. HammerFall requires nonzero window, pressed A, held L/R and the x683 threshold before drop and ordinary Fall. Local setter/countdown expiry alone does not transition motion.

The helper directly returns cur_anim_frame for inclusive Hammer membership and zero otherwise, without floating-value validation. The entry call consumes this as its start-frame argument, consistent with the document's parameter-policy rather than clamp interpretation.

Accept supersession of fact:d99b4be9-75e7-464e-8c07-e36faae99dc9. Ignoring a potentially false starter result cannot establish an ensures-active postcondition. The exact meaning of false remains an accepted deferral.

Accept unresolved disposition of link:92a6e4bd-479c-48db-a745-d439c9357c57 without replacing its baseline record. The underlying relation is supported, but overlay application is associated with setup/motion membership, not a held-Hammer test. HammerFall enters ordinary Fall before conditional overlay cleanup; wording repair remains deferred.
